Should this stay as a pretty viewer or become a handoff CLI?

19 May
The strongest direction is the handoff CLI. The pretty viewer can help later, but it is not the proof of value.

The role of the next version is to compress messy project conversations into a decision artifact that another person can use in under five minutes.

What should we not build first?

19 May
Do not build the dashboard first. Do not treat raw transcript storage as the product. Do not add a social feed or workspace layer before the compression is useful.

Outcome: commit to a CLI that extracts the current thesis, discarded branches, risks, and next action from real chats.

What should happen next?

19 May
Next action: run the CLI on ten real timestamped chat exports and check whether the outcome section names the actual decision instead of generic handoff boilerplate.
